deployment.note: SIMPLE, 1 replica, 60-minute timeout. Batch job, not a server: the container transcribes one 30-second WAV sample and exits; there is no time-to-first-token, the measured output time is time-to-first-transcript. No Whisper/Gradio image exists in any market's required_images (checked live 25 Nov 2026), so the base is the pre-cached TensorFlow CUDA image (docker.io/tensorflow/tensorflow:2.17.0-gpu-jupyter) + pip install openai-whisper. The sample WAV is generated inside the container (ffmpeg sine+tone is NOT speech — see honest note in meta: a real speech sample must be supplied at run time; if none is supplied the run is marked INVALID, not measured).

meta.description: Profiler combo 04: openai-whisper large-v3 batch transcription on RTX 3090. Measures schedule, image pull, pip install, model download, time to first transcript.
meta.honest_note: The container must be given a real 30-second speech WAV (mounted or downloaded at run time). A synthetic tone is not speech and must not be counted as a transcription result. If no real sample is available at run time, record the run as NOT MEASURED.
meta.name: scout-profiler-04-whisper-large-v3

cmd: pip install -q openai-whisper && test -f /root/sample.wav || (echo 'NO SAMPLE WAV: supply /root/sample.wav' && exit 3) && whisper /root/sample.wav --model large-v3 --output_format txt --output_dir /root/out && cat /root/out/*.txt
